root_cause: The code mutates the sort key of an AVTree node (DTS2PTSNode.poc, part of the (poc, gop) key used by cmp_insert) via av_tree_enumerate()'s callback while the node remains linked in the tree, instead of removing the node, updating it, and re-inserting it (with collision handling) as required by AVTree's usage contract.
